scripts.build: rm -f ../ChromeBadgeDeleter.zip ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip && rm -rf .firefox_src && zip -r ../ChromeBadgeDeleter.zip . -x '*.git*' 'node_modules/*' '*.env*' 'package*.json' '.firefox_src*' && cp manifest.json manifest_firefox.json && node -e "let m=require('./manifest_firefox.json'); m.browser_specific_settings={gecko:{id:'badgerdev@robloxbadgedeleter.com', data_collection_permissions:{required:['none']}}}; m.background.scripts=[m.background.service_worker]; require('fs').writeFileSync('manifest_firefox.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, 2));" && zip -r ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip . -x '*.git*' 'manifest.json' 'node_modules/*' '*.env*' 'package*.json' '.firefox_src*' && printf "@ manifest_firefox.json\n@=manifest.json\n" | zipnote -w ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip && rm manifest_firefox.json
scripts.deploy:firefox: rm -rf .firefox_src && unzip -q ../FirefoxBadgeDeleter.zip -d .firefox_src && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && web-ext sign --source-dir .firefox_src --artifacts-dir ../artifacts --channel listed --api-key $WEB_EXT_API_KEY --api-secret $WEB_EXT_API_SECRET && rm -rf .firefox_src
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:chrome && npm run deploy:firefox
